name: dealer-comparison-page-builder
description: Build one in-depth comparison page between a car dealership and a single named competitor. Optimized for AEO/GEO citation, Google ranking on 'Dealer A vs Dealer B' queries, and sales floor enablement. Includes a 10-to-15 dimension comparison framework, fair-play rules (the competitor wins on at least one dimension for credibility), schema markup spec, and a sales floor talk track for when customers are cross-shopping. Pairs with dealer-store-positioning and dealer-aeo-content-brief.
